title: Add sell bill/invoice generation and straw color code field

requirements.text: Add a colorCode field to the SemenStraw type in the backend data model to store the color code of each semen straw
acceptanceCriteria: SemenStraw type includes a colorCode field of type Text
The colorCode field is optional or can be an empty string
Existing CRUD operations (addOrUpdateStraw, queries) handle the colorCode field

requirements.text: Update the AddStrawForm component to include an input field for straw color code
acceptanceCriteria: Add straw form displays a text input field labeled 'Color Code' or 'Straw Color Code'
The color code input is submitted along with other straw details when creating a new straw
Form validation allows the color code field to be optional

requirements.text: Update the EditStrawForm component to allow editing the straw color code
acceptanceCriteria: Edit straw form displays the current color code value in an editable text input
Updated color code is saved when the form is submitted
Color code field remains optional during editing

requirements.text: Display the color code column in the inventory table showing the color code for each semen straw record
acceptanceCriteria: InventoryTable component displays a 'Color Code' column
Each row shows the corresponding straw's color code value
Empty color codes display appropriately (e.g., '-' or empty cell)

requirements.text: Add a backend function to generate a sale bill/invoice with sale details including sale ID, date, buyer information, straw details, quantity sold, and price
acceptanceCriteria: Backend function accepts a sale ID and returns formatted bill/invoice data
Bill includes all sale details: sale ID, sale date, buyer name and contact, straw ID, bull ID, quantity, and total price
Function retrieves corresponding straw details for the sale record

requirements.text: Add a 'Generate Bill' or 'View Invoice' action button in the SalesHistory page for each sale record to display or download the sale bill
acceptanceCriteria: Each sale row in the sales history table displays a 'Generate Bill' or 'View Invoice' button
Clicking the button displays a formatted bill/invoice with all sale details
Bill includes business header, sale information, buyer details, item details, and total price
User can print or download the bill as a PDF

requirements.text: Create a frontend invoice/bill component that displays a formatted sale bill with a professional layout suitable for printing
acceptanceCriteria: Bill component displays business name/logo at the top
Shows invoice number (sale ID), date, and buyer information
Displays itemized details: straw ID, bull ID, color code, quantity, unit price, and total
Includes a print button and is print-optimized with proper CSS
Layout uses the agricultural theme with appropriate styling

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui files
Maintain single-actor architecture in the backend with all logic in backend/main.mo
Preserve existing SemenStraw and Sale data structures while adding the colorCode field
nonGoals: Integration with external invoicing or accounting software
Email delivery of bills to buyers
Batch bill generation for multiple sales
Payment tracking or payment status management
